summary: Named-profile resolver. resolve_storage(name, settings_parameters=None) loads the storage_profiles section through mountainash-settings (from MOUNTAINASH_PROFILES_CONFIG or caller-supplied SettingsParameters), materialises the provider's storage Profile from STORAGE_REGISTRY and the auth profile from auth-client's AUTH_REGISTRY, and validates the auth mode against the provider spec's supported_auth. Validation errors that touch secret: references are replaced with redacted ProfileResolutionError messages so credential values do not leak through exception text or __context__.
key_classes: StorageProfilesSettings — MountainAshBaseSettings model exposing storage_profiles: dict[str, StorageProfileBlock] plus an excluded reference_inputs metadata field
StorageProfileBlock — one named block: provider (STORAGE_REGISTRY key), parameters, optional auth
AuthBlock — auth section: optional mode (CONST_AUTH_PROFILES value) and parameters
_ReferenceLocationsSource — private CacheableSettingsSource that records where secret: references occur (shape only, never values) for redaction decisions
key_functions: resolve_storage(name, *, settings_parameters=None) -> tuple[StorageProfileProtocol, AuthProfile] — materialise and validate a named storage/auth pair
_build_params(name, settings_parameters) — builds SettingsParameters, rejects a caller-set settings_class, re-derives reference_inputs from runtime kwargs
_sensitive_validation(error, shape) — decides whether a pydantic ValidationError implicates a secret reference and must be redacted
extension_points: New providers become resolvable automatically once registered in STORAGE_REGISTRY (block.provider is the registry key)
New auth modes come from mountainash-auth-client's AUTH_REGISTRY; the loader adds no mapping of its own
Secret readers are injected through SettingsParameters(secret_store=...); the loader deliberately performs no resolver pass of its own
lifecycle_notes: Without settings_parameters, ambient config is read from the file named by the MOUNTAINASH_PROFILES_CONFIG environment variable
A caller-supplied SettingsParameters must leave settings_class unset; resolve_storage owns it and raises ProfileResolutionError otherwise
Omitted auth mode falls back to spec.default_auth; the pairing is checked against spec.supported_auth before an auth profile is built
Importing the module imports settings.storage.profiles to populate STORAGE_REGISTRY; requires the [http] extra (pydantic, mountainash-settings, auth-client)
documentation_hooks: Named profiles guide: YAML shape of storage_profiles (provider/parameters/auth.mode/auth.parameters)
Secret references (secret:<record>.<field>) and selecting a reader at the application boundary
Error reference: ProfileNotFoundError, ProfileResolutionError, UnsupportedAuthProfileError and when each is raised
Security note: redaction of secret-bearing validation errors
examples: examples/named_profiles/example.py — resolves a named profile from profiles.yaml and handles ProfileNotFoundError
examples/named_profiles/profiles.yaml — config shape consumed by resolve_storage
risks: UnsupportedAuthProfileError is imported lazily from connections.errors inside resolve_storage, so the settings layer has a runtime dependency on the connections layer

Redaction depends on _ReferenceLocationsSource capture and _reference_shape mirroring kwargs; a change in mountainash-settings source capture semantics could silently disable redaction (reference_inputs is a reserved key and raises ValueError if present in config)
Docstring calls this 'the load_storage successor'; load_storage no longer exists, so that reference is historical
